blocks.html: Utility and miscellaneous Group U buildings and structures, including substantial improvement of such buildings and structures, shall be elevated such that the lowest floor, including basement, is elevated to or above the design flood elevation specified in ASCE 24, unless otherwise permitted to comply with requirements of Section 9.4 of ASCE 24.
